recognitionRules: Give each slide one large Arial action heading and a small timing label.
Use white instructional type on the blue opening field, then blue emphasis within the quiet white reading layouts.
Place the starting request and worked example in clearly separate areas.
Keep write, speak or think options visible without making one the default.

writingLinks.name: Patient coach
writingLinks.reason: Gradual release from worked example to a retry guided by feedback.

quote: Try it once. Notice what is missing. Make the next version clearer.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use TRY AND REFLECT in Arial with two short parallel strokes, the second slightly longer. Avoid a completion checkmark.
invariants: Give each slide one large Arial action heading and a small timing label.
Use white instructional type on the blue opening field, then blue emphasis within the quiet white reading layouts.
Place the starting request and worked example in clearly separate areas.
adaptations: A handout can put attempt and reflection on one page.
Keep timing as a plan unless it has been measured.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
